intent: An editorial accordion with serif headline, numbered questions and quietly revealed answers for studio FAQs, product details and help sections.

layout.direction: An editorial answer index with a 12px monospaced kicker, a responsive Instrument Serif heading and numbered question rows separated by fine rules. A plus/minus marks each disclosure and the open plain-text answer aligns with its question at 15px with 28px leading. Keep neutral graphite surfaces, 44px targets, readable spacing and long-copy wrapping.
layout.container: Full-width borderless index capped at 672px, with 24px padding and 40px at the enclosing @md container breakpoint. The separate demo stage uses 16px padding, rising to 32px at the sm viewport breakpoint.

typography.body: font-sans answers at 15px with 28px leading; 16px medium question labels
typography.metadata: 12px monospaced numbered questions and uppercase editorial kicker
typography.heading: 32-48px Instrument Serif title, 16px medium questions

motion.entrance: Enter the whole index with opacity and an 8px rise over 320ms.
motion.interaction: Mount and reveal only the visible answer with opacity and a 4px rise over 240ms. Keep 150ms question-button feedback.
motion.reduced: Subscribe to live prefers-reduced-motion changes and stop and settle the owned index/answer controls immediately. Remove press transforms.

responsive.rules: Wrap long copy; stack secondary details inside narrow containers; keep any horizontal scrolling local and keyboard accessible.

accessibility: Use native buttons and form controls with visible 2px focus rings.
Provide labels, meaningful states and polite feedback where actions update content.
Keep IDs instance-scoped with useId; support multiple instances and empty custom data.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion; no automatic action or navigation.

content.defaults: Use the realistic default content from the source; expose content and collection inputs as typed props.

props.name: items
props.description: Questions with stable unique IDs and plain-text answers. ID keys retain focused disclosures through reordering.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initially expanded item ID. An empty or missing ID starts with no matching answer; later matching items use the retained local open ID.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Optional synchronous notification with the locally opened ID or null after closure. Disclosure remains usable without a callback.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface and ink palette; the demo stage follows the chosen theme.

avoid: Remote images, fake network success or hidden external dependencies.
Decorative status badges, gradients as filler, low-contrast text.
Unlabelled controls, hover-only functionality, overflow at 320px.
contract: Preserve AccordionEntry, AccordionIndexProps and the named AccordionIndex export. Keep one local expanded ID, initialized from defaultOpen. Opening a question closes the prior answer; choosing the same question closes it.

Use native disclosure buttons with Enter/Space activation, aria-expanded and aria-controls. Every target region has a matching instance-scoped ID and trigger label; closed regions stay hidden and their answer content is not animated in the background.
Key question rows by stable unique IDs so host reordering retains focused disclosures and the actual open question. Missing IDs do not open an unrelated answer by position.
Notify onOpenChange synchronously with the chosen ID or null. It observes local disclosure rather than acting as an asynchronous save or controlled approval.
Keep written empty content, later-arriving questions, long headings/questions/answers and independent instances with unique IDs. Wrap content without document overflow.
The host owns publishing and editing the answers. Supply plain strings and use the callback for integration when useful; disclosure needs no network operation.
